identity.name: OpenMM 8.2.0 DHFR PME replica ensemble on one GPU
identity.fixed_work_driver: dhfr_ensemble.py code block supplied in brief; not part of upstream repository

found_evidence.scope: Public upstream DHFR benchmark with brief-supplied fixed-work adaptation; no substitution.

outcome_definition.primary: Minimize wall time to complete all eight independent 25000-step replicas on one GPU.
outcome_definition.speedup: sequential_total_wall_s / candidate_total_wall_s for identical fixed work
outcome_definition.scientific_outcomes: Per replica mean and final potential energy in kJ/mol; brief additionally asks unchanged energy series, which supplied driver does not persist.

citations.supports: Public executable PME benchmark and model defaults
Published MPS experiment, command and contextual throughput observation
CUDA precision and deterministic forces properties
Fixed-work driver, seeds, outcome proposal and intended-use permission statement

source_licences.intended_use: Local execution, scientific benchmarking and modification

components.component: OpenMM API, Reference and CPU platforms

components.licence: Distributed with OpenMM; brief explicitly states local running and modification permitted. Separate input-specific licence not established.

components.permission: Supplied for this benchmark execution in brief. No separate public licence identified.

source_licences.redistribution_reason: Redistribution outside intended local use not assessed.

stock_cuda_image.feasibility: Provisionally plausible on compatible Linux x86_64 CUDA 12 host; actual stock image unknown.
evidence: OpenMM 8.2.0 has CPython 3.10-3.13 manylinux x86_64 wheels.
OpenMM-CUDA-12 8.2.0 has manylinux x86_64 wheel and NVIDIA CUDA 12 runtime, nvcc, NVRTC, CUPTI and cuFFT dependencies.
Brief requires one NVIDIA GPU and driver supporting CUDA 12.
unknowns: Stock image identity, Python ABI, architecture, glibc and driver not supplied.
CUDA execution, MPS availability and permissions not reproduced.

size.reason: No measured or published peak host/GPU working set for sequential or concurrent eight-replica workload; input size alone cannot establish category.

scoring.objective: Lower ensemble total_wall_s; report aggregate_ns_per_day and speedup.
scoring.published_acceptance_criterion_reason: No independently published fixed-work wall-time or energy acceptance rule. Brief speedup ranges are hypotheses, not published measurements.
scoring.reference_use: Context only; null tolerance gives no pass/fail gate.

scientific_correctness.brief_proposal: Same-seed energy series identical for same GPU model/software/deterministic forces, otherwise mean differences no greater than sequential run-to-run variation.
scientific_correctness.reason: No published tolerance or measured baseline variation; cannot invent threshold.

repeatability_rules.replica_order: Baseline sequential index 0 through 7 in one process.
repeatability_rules.repeat_count_reason: Brief provides no number of repeat trials.
repeatability_rules.seeding: Each seed 1000+i applied to both velocity initialization and integrator random stream.
repeatability_rules.cuda_determinism: Documented DeterministicForces; full trajectory equivalence under concurrency untested.
repeatability_rules.cpu_evidence: Brief reports only two replicas of 250 steps on CPU; not representative CUDA performance or correctness evidence.

search_reason: Only sources named by brief inspected; no alternative benchmark search.
gate_scripts_reason: Prompt and brief name no intake gate scripts.
